svg.title: ArchLang is an open-source language that compiles plain-text source into floor plans. The card shows a brief given to Claude Fable and the ArchLang it wrote compiling into a dimensioned plan: 3 rooms, 35 m². Then one number is changed and the plan redraws, and a lint finding is raised and cleared. Last, the stage switches to 3D: the same source rises in the archlang-3d viewer and turns a full circle so every room can be seen from inside, while its command line writes the GLB and passes 4 checks. Output: SVG, PDF, DXF, PNG, GLB.
